model: SLC24-16B SLC line 16-way BC24 master (fire / smoke damper controller)
equipment_type: Fire / smoke damper actuator controller (16-way line master)
applies_to: BV-Control SLC24-16B masters controlling up to 16 BC24 fire or smoke damper slave modules on one SLC line.
summary: The SLC24-16B is a line master for up to 16 fire or smoke damper slave modules. Over BACnet it gives each slave a status, a damper position, a forced-control command, an active flag, a reset and eight live plus seven stored error flags. A heartbeat value must keep changing for BMS forced control to stay in effect.
notes: The object list (German headings, English object names) gives no read/write column; access is inferred from the object types and headings.
Status and position multistate texts are printed as lists without numbers; they are given here in order.
BI 0-127 are live errors and BI 128-239 stored (Mem) errors, 16 per error type, one per slave.
The document is dated November 2016 and sits in an "alt" (old) folder on the maker's site; a newer list may exist.
The BACnet transport is not stated in the list.

integration.summary: Read MV 0-15 for each slave's status and MV 16-31 for damper positions, and map the error BIs for alarms. To drive dampers from the BMS, write the BO forced-control commands and keep toggling BV 32 Control Heartbeat at least every 2 minutes.

minimum_points.name: Control Heartbeat
minimum_points.why: Heartbeat; change at least every 2 min

minimum_points.name: Reset 1
minimum_points.why: Reset slave 1 after an error (BV 17-31 others)

integration.enable: BMS forced control (BO 0-15) stays active only while BV 32 Control Heartbeat keeps changing; otherwise local forced control applies.
integration.heartbeat: BV 32 must change value at least once every two minutes or the master falls back to local forced control. The check can be turned off in the CDU software.
setup: BV 0-15 mark which slave positions are in use.
gotchas: Resets (BV 16-31) only work while the slave has an active or stored error.
Stored (Mem) errors stay set after the live error clears until reset.
